facts.business: Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited is a diversified FMCG-led company operating across textiles, FMCG, FMCG intermediates, and edibles with manufacturing facilities in Rajasthan and Assam.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Medium-term aspiration of approximately Rs 1,000 crore in revenues by FY2028

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Emergence of FMCG as a new reportable segment (Ind AS 108) involving significant management judgement in segment identification and allocation of common costs and assets between Textile and FMCG businesses with no prior-year benchmark.

key_risks: Segment identification and allocation of common costs/assets between Textile and FMCG involves significant management judgement
Inventory turnover ratio declined 51.55% due to addition of FMCG division increasing overall inventory
Liquidity risk management dependent on maintaining adequate reserves and banking facilities
